result: INCOMPLETE: dlopen/dlerror work end to end in Liella's ld.so and libc (new test green kernel-started and as ld.so PROGRAM, 5/5 plants caught); direct gate has 1 unexplained failure (xtask affected selection test); differences rows, compat and D-27 records still owed
informational: Probe (ruling #5266, tools/probe/dl/gaps): the reference loads objects with e_ehsize 0 or a PT_LOAD p_align of 3; Liella's ELF reader refuses both ('malformed ELF object'). Recommend keeping the refusal and recording it as a differences row in the next run.

The C library's start stores its own __libc_stack_end, and after 'ld.so PROGRAM' the start's stack words are rearranged: the loader now records argc/argv/envp/auxv in run_init (START_ARGS) instead of re-reading the stack.
Run 1's guessed texts were wrong for other EI_CLASS values and for a missing PT_DYNAMIC; both now follow the probe.
xtask/src/policy.rs: the 'slice' unsafe category is now permitted in boundary src/ld/ and src/dlerr.rs (same trust as src/ld.rs).

impact.what: dlopen/dlerror in dynamic programs: unblocks DL-16b (dlsym), DL-16c, DL-16d and CONF-DYN-HELPERS' dlopen programs
crates/ld/tests/dlopen.rs (24 checks, 2 start modes) and 5 plants, all caught
dlopen texts for 9 malformed-header cases now match the reference (probe)

improvement: The loader's start data that dlopen needs should have one documented record (START_OBJS/START_ARGS) from the start: re-reading the initial stack later is unsafe after ld.so PROGRAM, and that cost a debug cycle here.
next_step: Explain and fix the a_loader_change_does_not_select_the_math_suites failure (compare against origin/next first), then the COMPAT-NEW and D-NEW records plus differences rows for #5125/#5126, a static-program test and liella_ld::dlopen unit tests (handoff/DL-DLOPEN-LOAD.md).
